say:10:1660212009:1.text: Their faces are twisted with fury, eyes blazing. It's as if they want to tear the Sunlit Tribe refugees apart.

say:17:1660213012:0.text: Hand over <style="highlight">whatever treasure your old man stashed</style>, and maybe I'll let you limp away!

say:19:1660213014:0.text: Lies! The <style="highlight">autumn curse</style> has rotted your wretched soul! Nothing true ever comes out of that mouth!

say:21:1660213015:0.text: Whoa there, hey! Can we all just cool it a second?!
say:21:1660213015:0.source_cn: 嘿，老、老兄！你们冷静点儿！

say:22:1660213016:0.text: Don't you see the backup we've got here?

say:26:1660213019:0.male: You're with them? You're helping these thieves?
say:26:1660213019:0.female: You're with them? You're helping these thieves?

say:28:1660213020:0.text: Perhaps someone could explain what this "autumn curse" is about?
say:28:1660213020:0.source_cn: 或许有人愿意告诉我们，什么是秋日诅咒？

say:29:1660213021:1.text: Ahh, you must be new around here! No wonder you haven't heard!
say:29:1660213021:1.source_cn: 哦我的朋友，你刚来秋之国，难怪不知道！

say:31:1660213022:0.text: The autumn curse rots the soul. It turns folks into cunning liars who'll trick you out of everything you own.
say:31:1660213022:0.source_cn: 秋日诅咒是一些被邪恶力量腐蚀了心肝的人，他们会不择手段...

say:32:1660213023:0.text: My father lost everything to someone cursed like that...
say:32:1660213023:0.source_cn: 我的父亲也被一个得了秋日诅咒的人骗走了一切……

say:34:1660213024:0.text: Your father was one of them! That snake stole a fortune from me!
say:34:1660213024:0.source_cn: 你的父亲也是个该死的受诅者，他骗了我一大笔钱！

say:35:1660213025:0.text: I... I can earn it back, I swear! I'll repay every coin!
say:35:1660213025:0.source_cn: 我、我能赚钱！我之后会还给你的！

say:36:1660213026:0.text: Back then, you had the Autumn Guild behind you. You could wave a candy stick and folks would trade you rubies! But now, you've got nothing!

say:37:1660213027:0.text: Now hold on, fellas! These folks are Master Rowan's friends. Real capable types. If I were you, I'd be backing off real quick!
say:37:1660213027:0.source_cn: 哎呀，老兄们，这几位可是罗万少爷的朋友，个顶个的好手，...

say:38:1660213028:0.text: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!
say:38:1660213028:0.source_cn: 要是不乖乖调头回去，哼哼……等到我们这位朋友出手，恐怕...

say:40:1660213029:0.female: Come on now, Magister, look at the situation! We need you!

say:41:1660213031:0.text: Odie, I told you to keep quiet! This is a family matter. Don't drag strangers into it!
say:41:1660213031:0.source_cn: 阿德，都让你别信口雌黄，这是我们家的事情，不能把无辜的...

say:42:1660213032:1.text: Sir... sorry, young master... I'm just trying to keep us alive. We can make more coin, but we can't grow a new head.

say:45:1660213034:1.text: Hearing that, Odie reluctantly raises his blowgun.
say:45:1660213034:1.source_cn: 阿德闻言，只能拿起了吹箭。

say:46:1660213035:1.text: Aww, shoot... guess the jig is up.
say:46:1660213035:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，看来是瞒不过去了……

say:47:1660213036:1.text: Cursed rats! I knew you were conning us!
say:47:1660213036:1.source_cn: 该死的诅咒者，你们果然在骗人！

say:3:1660214003:0.text: Master Rowan, you do remember what we agreed on, right?
say:3:1660214003:0.source_cn: 罗万少爷，我们之前说好的事，你还记不记得？

say:4:1660214004:0.text: I do. I said I'd follow you. But I never agreed to lie for a living.
say:4:1660214004:0.source_cn: 我记得，跟着你跑路，就要听你的话。可是我不想骗人。

say:5:1660214005:1.text: Young master, I've seen what the autumn curse does. It makes people paranoid. Turns them against everyone.
say:5:1660214005:1.source_cn: 少爷呀，我见过真正的秋日诅咒，那些得了秋日诅咒的人像疯...

say:6:1660214006:0.text: Taking money from crooks or cursed folks—how's that a crime? We're doing them a favor before they go off the deep end!
say:6:1660214006:0.source_cn: 从骗子手里敛财怎么能算骗呢，要我说，咱们就该专挑那些中...

say:7:1660214007:0.text: That's exactly what people said about my father. He was cheated, and then he turned around and did the same to others.
say:7:1660214007:0.source_cn: 那不就和那些人说的一样，像我父亲一样，被人欺骗，然后再...

say:8:1660214008:0.text: I don't care how broke I am. I won't lie to survive. Once I make money, I'll pay you triple what I owe. That's a promise!
say:8:1660214008:0.source_cn: 听好，哪怕穷得去流浪也不能去骗人。等我之后赚了钱，你的...

say:9:1660214009:0.text: You do realize we're already living like vagrants, right? And who knows when this magical payday of yours will arrive, if ever?
say:9:1660214009:0.source_cn: 哎呀，咱们已经差不多算是在流浪了嘛……少爷您说的好事不...

say:10:1660214010:0.text: I always keep my word. You'll see!
say:10:1660214010:0.source_cn: 我说话算话，一定会做到的！

say:11:1660214011:1.text: Rowan finishes, then turns to thank you.
say:11:1660214011:1.source_cn: 罗万说完，又转过身对你们致谢。
say:11:1660214011:1.male: Rowan finishes, then turns to thank you.
say:11:1660214011:1.female: Rowan finishes, then turns to thank you.

say:12:1660214012:0.text: Thank you for helping back there. And... I hate to ask, but I could really use your help again.
say:12:1660214012:0.source_cn: 刚才多谢你们……我、我还有一个请求，可以请你们帮帮我吗？
say:12:1660214012:0.male: Thank you for helping back there. And... I hate to ask, but I could really use your help again.
say:12:1660214012:0.female: Thank you for helping back there. And... I hate to ask, but I could really use your help again.

say:13:1660214013:0.text: Oho! The young master's got some gall, I'll give him that!
say:13:1660214013:0.source_cn: 哦，少爷，你的脸皮还是挺厚的嘛！

say:15:1660214015:0.text: Look, I don't have any money right now, but one day I will, and when that day comes, I'll make it up to you, I promise. Just... please, hear me out. Give me a chance!

choice_prompt:16:1660214015.text: Look, I don't have any money right now, but one day I will, and when that day comes, I'll make it up to you, I promise. Just... please, hear me out. Give me a chance!
choice_prompt:16:1660214015.source_cn: 几位……我现在没有钱，但之后我一定会赚很多钱，到时候我一定给你们送上一份贵重的谢礼。希望你们能听听我的请求，给我一个机会！

say:17:1660214016:0.text: I need to go back to the place I used to live. There's something there I can't leave behind.
say:17:1660214016:0.source_cn: 我想回我之前的家一趟，我有很重要的东西要拿回来。

say:18:1660214017:0.text: Knew it! I told you, his old man totally stashed a treasure before he was gone!
say:18:1660214017:0.source_cn: 哦，我就知道、我就知道！老爷果然在离开前给你藏了一笔宝藏！

say:19:1660214018:0.text: This could be it, folks! The payday to end all paydays!
say:19:1660214018:0.source_cn: 各位，这是千载难逢的机会，说不定能发大财！

say:20:1660214019:0.text: It's not like that. Ugh... forget it.
say:20:1660214019:0.source_cn: 不是你想的那样！唉……算了。

say:0:1660215001:2.female: You arrive at the old manor. The garden has withered from neglect, casting a bleak, abandoned look over the entire place.

say:1:1660215002:0.source_cn: 罗万却没有向城堡里走，他在花园里七拐八绕，来到一个水池旁边。

say:3:1660215003:0.source_cn: 布拉达克一世！你在哪里？！

say:7:1660215005:0.text: Young master... you came all this way for that... duck? Doesn't look like it's made of gold to me.
say:7:1660215005:0.source_cn: 少爷啊，你千里迢迢赶回这里，就为了这只……鸭子？它看着...

say:8:1660215006:0.text: That's not just any duck. That's my dearest friend!

say:10:1660215007:0.text: They used to say Bradduck brought good fortune. I denied it. No one believed me.
say:10:1660215007:0.source_cn: 过去，有人说布拉达克一世能带来财运，我否认了，可没人相信。

say:11:1660215008:0.text: Now I say I've got nothing, and still, no one believes me.
say:11:1660215008:0.source_cn: 现在，我说我一无所有，还是没人相信。

say:12:1660215009:0.text: But I will reclaim it all—the house, the guild, the life I lost... one piece at a time. Starting with Bradduck!
say:12:1660215009:0.source_cn: 庄园、古董、商会……总有一天，我会像接回布拉达克一世一...

say:13:1660215010:0.text: Rowan looks at each of you, watching your reactions carefully, as though he's bracing for someone to laugh.
say:13:1660215010:0.source_cn: 罗万一边说，一边打量着你们的神情，好像生怕你们不信一样。

say:6:1660216005:1.source_cn: 罗万几乎是在大喊了，即便如此，他的声音听起来也断断续续...

say:8:1660216006:0.text: You wouldn't guess it, but this is someone's dream, too.
say:8:1660216006:0.source_cn: 你也许难以置信，这里是另一个人的梦境。

choice_prompt:10:1660216007.source_cn: 谁的梦里，会是这样的暴风雪啊！

say:14:1660216010:0.text: That joke was drier than this barren land!
say:14:1660216010:0.source_cn: 你的笑话比这暴风雪还要冷！
say:14:1660216010:0.male: That joke was drier than this barren land!
say:14:1660216010:0.female: That joke was drier than this barren land!

say:15:1660216011:1.text: Suddenly, Soren comes to a stop. You step forward and notice the grave look on his face.

say:18:1660216014:1.text: You look down, but all you see is snow. There's nothing to make sense of.
say:18:1660216014:1.source_cn: 你看向地面，到处都是积雪，什么都看不出来。
say:18:1660216014:1.male: You look down, but all you see is snow. There's nothing to make sense of.
say:18:1660216014:1.female: You look down, but all you see is snow. There's nothing to make sense of.

say:19:1660216015:1.text: Then we keep moving... Fate might guide us where we need to go.
say:19:1660216015:1.source_cn: 事已至此，我们便继续向前吧……命运会引领我们走向应许之处。

choice_prompt:20:1660216015.text: Then we keep moving... Fate might guide us where we need to go.

say:35:1660216027:0.source_cn: 的确，我们应该也受到了冬日诅咒的影响，才会这样沮丧和消极。

say:36:1660216028:0.text: I've traveled across deserts and warzones just to make a trade. And now I'm ready to give up because of a snowstorm? That's not me.
say:36:1660216028:0.source_cn: 对啊，我到处行商，经历的事情那么多，怎么会被一场暴风雪...

say:37:1660216029:0.text: The curse is getting worse. If we don't move faster, it'll bury us before the snow does.

say:2:1660220003:0.text: The town lies in unsettling silence. No voices, no footsteps, like someone hit pause on the whole world.
say:2:1660220003:0.source_cn: 城镇中一片寂静，听不到任何声音，好像所有人都陷入了沉眠。

say:4:1660220004:0.text: Your friends are still trapped inside the dream. That's all the reason you need to keep going. Fear doesn't get a say.
say:4:1660220004:0.source_cn: 想到梦境中等待的朋友，你心中充满勇气，毫不在意周围的黑暗。

say:4:1660220004:0.female: Your friends are still trapped inside the dream. That's all the reason you need to keep going. Fear doesn't get a say.

say:5:1660220006:1.male: Something's been watching you in the dark. A whole bunch of them, actually. And none of them mean you well.

say:7:1660220005:1.female: And you're right to be cautious.

say:5:1660221005:1.text: Keep at it... You'll be the next hero this world remembers.
